question.title: In-Place Singly Linked List Reversal
question.prompt: Write an algorithm or C++ function to reverse a singly linked list in O(n) time and O(1) auxiliary space. Clearly handle edge cases and return the pointer to the new head of the reversed list.
question.solutionNotes: Must use iterative 3-pointer manipulation (prev, curr, next). Must handle empty list (head == NULL) and single node gracefully. Must return prev as new head. Penalize any auxiliary arrays or O(n) space.

sectionSpecificAllowances.sec_a: Prof. Tariq Mahmud: Accept both nullptr and NULL. In Section A, students were told returning prev without modifying head variable in caller is full credit if function returns Node*.
sectionSpecificAllowances.sec_b: Lec. Nusrat Jahan: Standard iterative textbook approach required. Explicit check for head == NULL.
sectionSpecificAllowances.sec_c: Dr. Kazi Tanvir Ahmed: Recursive helper reversal permitted if auxiliary stack space is acknowledged.

rubricCriteria.title: Base & Edge Cases
rubricCriteria.description: Correct handling of empty list (head == NULL) and single-node list (head->next == NULL).
rubricCriteria.fullCredit: Gracefully returns head or NULL without segmentation fault (1.0 mark).
rubricCriteria.partialCredit: Checks for NULL head but misses single-node condition or minor boundary bug (0.5 marks).
rubricCriteria.zeroCredit: No edge case handling; triggers null pointer dereference (0.0 marks).

rubricCriteria.title: Core Pointer Reversal Logic
rubricCriteria.description: Iterative 3-pointer traversal (prev, curr, next) reversing links in O(n) time.
rubricCriteria.fullCredit: Flawless loop structure, correct next storage, curr->next reversal, and pointer shifting (2.5 marks).
rubricCriteria.partialCredit: 3-pointer strategy used, but order of assignment contains a flaw or lost pointer (1.0 - 1.5 marks).
rubricCriteria.zeroCredit: Completely flawed traversal logic, infinite loop, or disconnected nodes (0.0 marks).

rubricCriteria.title: Return Value & List Integrity
rubricCriteria.description: Correctly updates head or returns 'prev' as the new head pointer of the reversed list.
rubricCriteria.fullCredit: Returns new head (prev) and ensures original head now points to NULL as tail (1.5 marks).
rubricCriteria.partialCredit: List is inverted but returns void or forgets to return prev to caller (0.5 marks).
rubricCriteria.zeroCredit: Returns original head (which now points to NULL, losing the entire list) (0.0 marks).

penalties.title: Auxiliary Space Violation (> O(1))
penalties.description: Used vector, stack, or auxiliary array to store values rather than in-place reversal.

penalties.title: Memory Leak / Dangling Pointer
penalties.description: Leaves intermediate nodes unreferenced or introduces dangling memory.
